No-local-SDK constraint drives CI verification, no-codegen and prefs persistence

nodes.label: CommandAck acknowledgement
nodes.rationale: Notification on charCommandAck correlated by commandId; status codes ok/rejectedUnsafe/rejectedUnsupported/malformed/busy/protocolMismatch.

nodes.label: BleIds / placeholder UUIDs
nodes.rationale: All UUIDs are development placeholders in ble_ids.dart and MUST be confirmed with firmware before production.

nodes.label: Handshake and version negotiation
nodes.rationale: Encoding is versioned; unknown versions rejected via negotiation with ack protocolMismatch surfacing recovery.

nodes.label: DeviceCapabilities (revA profile)
nodes.rationale: DeviceCapabilities.revA is the reference profile the simulator uses and the conservative default; real units return their own blob and the UI is driven entirely by it.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions CI pipeline
nodes.rationale: Format/analyze/test (43 tests), Android debug build, iOS no-codesign build; verification via CI since the authoring machine has no Flutter SDK.

nodes.label: Security gates before consumer release
nodes.rationale: Authenticated replay-resistant BLE control, signed versioned firmware update, verified log scrubbing, re-reviewed threat model; do not ship placeholder UUIDs unconfirmed.

nodes.label: Insecure firmware update threat
nodes.rationale: Update path is a placeholder only (disabled); production needs signed, versioned images with rollback protection and verify-before-flash.

nodes.label: BLE contract testing (FakeTransport)
nodes.rationale: fake_transport.dart is a programmable DeviceTransport; tests script delayed/duplicate ack, dropped packet, connect failure, mid-apply disconnect deterministically without hardware.

nodes.label: Capability-driven UI
nodes.rationale: Unsupported features render 'Not supported', never faked; UI driven entirely by negotiated capabilities.

nodes.label: SafetyGovernor
nodes.rationale: Safety as a layer: clamps toward safe values before send and reports every adjustment; firmware remains authoritative.

nodes.label: Accessibility requirements
nodes.rationale: Contrast, semantic labels, text scaling, reduced motion, light/dark.

nodes.label: Looks (curated + user)
nodes.rationale: Curated built-in + user looks: save/rename/duplicate/favourite/delete/re-apply; persistence across restarts.

nodes.label: Safety requirements
nodes.rationale: Safe default intensity, firmware-capped brightness, thermal suspension, emergency illumination-off, experimental-hardware labelling.

nodes.label: Per-zone customization
nodes.rationale: Whole-frame + independent front/left-temple/right-temple customization with colours persisted per zone.

nodes.label: MVP must-have requirements
nodes.rationale: Complete simulator experience, per-zone customization, solid/gradient color, curated+user looks, pairing flow, command/ack pipeline, safety, capability-driven device health, accessibility.

nodes.label: Local-first storage
nodes.rationale: Looks and last-applied appearance in shared_preferences; authorized-device ref in flutter_secure_storage; telemetry in-memory only; nothing uploaded.

nodes.label: bootstrap_platforms.sh
nodes.rationale: android/ and ios/ are not committed; the script runs flutter create, applies manifests/Info.plist and sets com.shadeshifter.app identity.

nodes.label: Contextual runtime permission flow (permission_handler)
nodes.rationale: Runtime requests made contextually at pairing, never on launch (Phase 3).

nodes.label: Android BLE permissions overlay
nodes.rationale: API 31+ BLUETOOTH_SCAN (neverForLocation)+BLUETOOTH_CONNECT; API<=30 legacy BLUETOOTH/ADMIN + fine-location; no location derived from BLE.

nodes.label: iOS Bluetooth usage descriptions
nodes.rationale: NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription/NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription applied via PlistBuddy; prompt appears at pairing not launch. Min iOS 13.

nodes.label: AppLogger.redactId
nodes.rationale: Reduces device identifiers to AB••••EF so raw BLE MAC addresses never reach normal logs; diagnostics export sanitized.

nodes.label: Sensitive logs threat
nodes.rationale: redactId() + sanitized diagnostics today; production adds log-scrubbing tests and no verbose BLE dumps in release.

nodes.label: Trust boundaries
nodes.rationale: Everything received over BLE is untrusted and validated/size-bounded; firmware safety limits are authoritative and SafetyGovernor is a second clamping layer.

nodes.label: Privacy by design (guest-first)
nodes.rationale: No account/login; no background scanning; no location; no advertising identifiers, analytics or ad/attribution SDKs. Nothing to leak.

nodes.label: DeviceTransport interface
nodes.rationale: UI and business logic never depend on the BLE package; they talk to a DeviceTransport interface so simulator, test fake, and physical BLE transport are drop-in interchangeable.

nodes.label: TransportFactory
nodes.rationale: createFor(DeviceRef) selects the transport implementation; nothing above the factory branches on transport type.

nodes.label: BleTransport (flutter_blue_plus)
nodes.rationale: Not yet implemented; deliberately kept out of the compiled tree so CI stays green without a device/SDK (ADR 0003). The next hardware task.

nodes.label: Feature-first clean architecture
nodes.rationale: Layered Presentation/Application/Domain/Infrastructure with a transport seam so BLE stays out of UI and logic.

nodes.label: No code-gen decision
nodes.rationale: Hand-written immutable models + manual providers instead of Freezed/json_serializable/riverpod_generator, keeping the tree compilable without codegen (ADR 0002/0003).

nodes.label: CommandCodec
nodes.rationale: Authoritative binary encode/decode in command_codec.dart + protocol.dart, verified by test vectors.

nodes.label: Command frame layout
nodes.rationale: Fixed header (protocolVersion, messageType, commandId, sequence, targetZone, payloadLength) + payload + XOR checksum; big-endian.

nodes.label: Authentication gap (POC to production)
nodes.rationale: Biggest gap: the POC BLE link is open/unauthenticated. Production needs authenticated + replay-resistant control (pairing key/bonding, per-session nonce).

nodes.label: Replay attack mitigation
nodes.rationale: monotonic uint32 sequence + commandId in every frame; production must reject non-increasing sequence and add a rolling MAC/signature.

nodes.label: Command codec test vectors
nodes.rationale: command_codec_test.dart covers binary frame layout, test vectors, checksum verify/corruption, gradient/empty/rename payloads.

nodes.label: Compact binary wire encoding
nodes.rationale: Fixed-size header + small payloads keep within a single BLE MTU and are cheap to parse on the ESP32; JSON only for simulator/debug.

nodes.label: ADR 0001 — Isolate BLE behind DeviceTransport interface
nodes.norm_label: adr 0001 — isolate ble behind devicetransport interface

nodes.label: ADR 0002 — Hand-written models & providers (no build_runner code-gen)
nodes.norm_label: adr 0002 — hand-written models & providers (no build_runner code-gen)

nodes.label: ADR 0003 — Build/test verification happens in CI, not locally
nodes.norm_label: adr 0003 — build/test verification happens in ci, not locally

nodes.label: ADR 0004 — Local persistence: preferences now, Drift later
nodes.norm_label: adr 0004 — local persistence: preferences now, drift later

nodes.label: Frame state synchronization flow
nodes.rationale: Immediate local preview, 120ms debounce coalesces drags, SafetyGovernor sanitize, send per zone with timeout+retry, correlate ack by commandId, persist last-applied appearance.

nodes.label: 120ms UI debounce
nodes.rationale: Continuous UI controls debounced 120ms before transmit to coalesce drags and rate-limit the link.

nodes.label: Timeouts, retries, idempotency
nodes.rationale: 3s client timeout, up to 2 retries for transient failures with 150ms*attempt backoff, safe because commands are idempotent.

nodes.label: DoS via command flooding
nodes.rationale: 120ms debounce + bounded retry + idempotent commands rate-limit the link; production adds firmware-side rate limiting and backpressure.

nodes.label: Idempotent commands
nodes.rationale: Every command sets absolute state, so a retry after a lost ack is safe.

nodes.label: FramePreview (2D vector frame)
nodes.rationale: Custom-painted 2D vector frame is the reliable default and the graceful fallback for the future 3D view; works on low-end devices.

nodes.label: FramePreview3D (GLB 3D view)
nodes.rationale: Future real-3D view sits behind the same inputs as FramePreview; falls back to 2D on init failure or low-end devices.

nodes.label: Phase 7 firmware validation checklist
nodes.rationale: Confirm UUIDs, byte order/checksum/status codes, record real BLE MTU/latency, test state reconciliation, validate safe brightness/thermal thresholds against firmware.

nodes.label: Simulator-first vertical slice
nodes.rationale: Splash to onboarding to pairing to Try Simulator to Home; fully usable with no hardware.

nodes.label: Result over exceptions
nodes.rationale: Result/AppError used at every layer boundary instead of throwing exceptions.

nodes.label: iOS background modes (none)
nodes.rationale: Do not add bluetooth-central background mode unless a concrete requirement is agreed; it triggers extra App Review scrutiny and battery cost.

nodes.label: Safety UX (intensity ceiling, emergency off, POC labelling)
nodes.norm_label: safety ux (intensity ceiling, emergency off, poc labelling)
